office.title: Indiana State Representative
office.summary: Members of the Indiana House of Representatives write and vote on state laws as part of the Indiana General Assembly. The House has 100 members, each representing one district for a two-year term {wiki_in_house}.
duties: Introduces and votes on state legislation as one of the two chambers of the Indiana General Assembly {wiki_in_house}.
Must be at least 21 years old when taking office and have lived in the district for at least a year {wiki_in_house}.
